instruction: A compact backyard greenhouse: an aluminum frame skeleton with a pitched roof, translucent glazing panels suggested on the walls and roof, a hinged door with a handle, and low interior potting-bench silhouettes visible through the glass.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a backyard greenhouse. A compact backyard greenhouse: an aluminum frame skeleton with a pitched roof, translucent glazing panels suggested on the walls and roof, a hinged door with a handle, and low interior potting-bench silhouettes visible through the glass. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
